headline: Fidson Healthcare Nine-Month Net Profit Jumps 47% on Easing FX Pressures
summary: Fidson Healthcare Plc grew its nine-month net profit by 47.2 percent to N11.74 billion in 2026, outpacing a 21 percent revenue increase as foreign exchange pressures eased.
why: Fidson Healthcare is a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer in Nigeria, and its financial results reflect currency stability impacts on imported raw material costs.

impacts.name: Fidson Healthcare Plc
impacts.why: Lower foreign exchange pressure reduces input costs, expanding profit margins alongside revenue growth.
